pick.headline: The August coup collapses
pick.fbis: The Soviet Union Daily Report of August 22, 1991, carried the coup's collapse: Soviet radio on the arrests of Yanayev, Yazov, Kryuchkov and others, and Moscow TASS in English on Interior Minister Pugo's suicide.

evidence.title: FBIS Daily Report: Soviet Union, No. 163, 22 August 1991
evidence.snippet: …ov Arrest Announced LD2208074291 Moscow Radio Moscow World Service in Enelish 0700 GMT 22 Aue 91 [Text] It has been announced in Moscow that KGB chief Viadimir Kryuchkov was arrested. He and other mem- bers of the State Emergency Committee will be brought to trial TASS Reports Pugo Suicide LD2208090591 Moscow TASS in English O858 GM1 22 Aug 91 [Text] Moscow August 22 TASS—Soviet Interior Min- ister Boris Pugo, a member of the so-called Emergency Committee…

alternates.headline: Latvia declares independence
alternates.fbis: The Soviet Union Daily Report of August 22, 1991, carried Moscow TASS in English: on Wednesday the Latvian parliament passed a constitutional law declaring Latvia an independent democratic republic and ending the transitional period.

evidence.title: FBIS Daily Report: Soviet Union, No. 163, 22 August 1991
evidence.snippet: …year, a series of crimes was committed, some for which criminal proceedings have already been instituted. Involved in the commission of the crimes was the USSR Interior Ministry's special militia task force deployed in Latvia. The Presidium of the Supreme Council of the Republic of Latvia calls upon the special purpose militia detachment combatants who took part in violent acts to voluntarily report to the Procuracy of the Republic of Latvia…
